notes: The 2027 dates are not posted. If hired, you show a Social Security card and photo ID and pass a drug test. You need your own ride to work. The page title reads Museum Assistants.
name: Museum Assistants (Teen Assistants)
what_you_do: Teens from the St. Louis area learn about art and teach others about art from around the world.
who_can_apply: High school students from the St. Louis area. For 2026 you had to be 16 by June 1.
duration: Up to 24 hours a week in summer. At least 5 hours a month in the school year.
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran March 19 to April 15, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Use the Learn more and apply link on the museum's teen assistants page when the next window opens. A contact email is listed there.
